verdict.rationale: Docs describe outbound vs inbound concurrency reservation (retell-docs-11, retell-docs-41) and custom telephony/SIP integration, but there is no evidence of a batch outbound campaign feature — no mention of scheduling calls, uploading contact lists, or campaign-level throughput controls beyond general concurrency limits. Axis is plausible for a voice-agent platform but unsupported by the evidence pack.
